claims: Continue mechanical ventilation in SPONT/PSV mode with current settings, targeting light sedation (RASS -1 to -2) and weaning readiness.
Monitor arterial blood gas and ventilator parameters (tidal volume, respiratory rate, peak pressures, minute volume) to assess ventilation and oxygenation.
Perform daily sedation interruption and assess readiness for extubation given RASS -2 and improving oxygenation (FiO2 40%, PEEP 5).
Continue fentanyl infusion at 75 mcg/hour for analgesia, titrating to pain scores.
Continue propofol infusion for sedation, titrating to target RASS.
Monitor vital signs, including blood pressure (recent mean 48-51 mmHg), heart rate, and SpO2, with alarms set appropriately.
Obtain urine toxicology screen results and consider confirmatory testing; amphetamine screen is positive.
Replete electrolytes as needed, including potassium, magnesium, and calcium, and monitor levels.
Provide stress ulcer prophylaxis with famotidine and continue as ordered.
Implement VTE prophylaxis, mobility, and skin care per Braden score; consider physical therapy and occupational therapy consultation.
